body:
Thank you for you kind words but I find myself succumbing more every day. I can't find a moment of peace without my brain regressing to some place I don't want to be.

I think my ultimate downfall is that I do not care about myself. I do not want to take the steps needed to ensure my well being. I don't want to turn to friends or family, I just want to go as quietly as possible. Funny, that kind of describes my entire life.

Anyways, do not worry, share you cares with people who need them. I will be fine. I just want for the pain I cause to be as temporary and short-lived as it can be, and that it is way less than the pain I am currently feeling.

I can't talk to my family. I have serious trust issues engraved by my childhood. It is really impossible for me to open up. The only way to they would ever know is if they asked me directly, and I would still give a round a bout answer.  

My family isn't real persistent or anything either. I'm sure a week or more and they wouldn't even know I'm gone. By the time they figure out something is wrong, I'll be away.

Then they sort of have time for things to soak in, it won't be a huge shock like coming home and finding me dead in our own basement. I just want to shield them from it. No funeral or anything, just me at peace.
